title: The Devil Butler
blurb: As the Demon King, Yifan Zhuo uses his knowledge and power, collected over millennia, to defeat all foes, until the day he is betrayed. With his last breath, the demon king manages to reincarnate... but into the body of a puny young servant! To Yifan's dismay, the servant has a spirit bond with his mistress, Lady Luo. Yifan, now known as Fan, finds himself inexplicably drawn to Lady Luo and links his fate to her family. With Lady Luo at his side, will he regain his place as the Demon King?

title: Log Into The Future
blurb: 300 years after mutated beasts ravaged the world, humanity began to lose ground, with only martial arts as their last line of defense. Lu Sheng mysteriously gains the power to journey 10,000 years into the future, only to find humanity has disappeared. However, he acquires the culminated martial arts wisdom to fight back against these monsters, honing his skills to the pinnacle. Armed with this new-found knowledge, can Lu Sheng emerge as the final beacon of hope for humanity's survival?

title: Shut up, Evil Dragon, I Don't Want to Raise A Child with You Anymore
blurb:
The dragon slayer Leon was defeated and captured by the Silver Dragon Queen. With his life on the line, he tried to use forbidden magic to curse the dragon queen, but the curse had unexpected side effects, and the queen lost control as they had a one-night stand.
He thought that the shame she would carry for the rest of her life would be enough to fulfill his life's purpose as a dragon slayer.
But two years later, when Leon opened his eyes, he found a young dragon girl with a tail sleeping next to him…

title: Necromancer, the Ultimate Scourge!
blurb: In a world where magic and monsters exist, Lin Moyu has hit the age of acquiring his very own profession. While most would be lucky just to obtain a high-level combat class, Moyu becomes the ultrarare necromancer! Being the first and only one of his kind, he has no idea of the potential he possesses on his journey to level up and face great challenges. What new heights will Moyu achieve with his unique army of undead?

title: Perfect Life System: Double Cash for Her Favor
blurb: Miles Shen had it all—good looks, money, the works. Then everything collapsed. His family empire crumbled, he went from trust fund kid to drowning in debt, and his materialistic girlfriend kicked him to the curb without a backward glance. Just when he's hit absolute rock bottom, he gets the "Perfect Life System". The rules? Spend money on any girl who likes him enough (affection level over 60), and he gets double his money back! And just like that, Miles is living a life where normal people go broke from spending, but he just keeps getting richer. He's throwing money around like it's nothing, and somehow his bank account just keeps growing!

title: Martial Peak
blurb:
The peak of martial arts is solitary and lonely. It is an endless pursuit for unattainable heights as well. In order to surpass the limits of martial arts, growth and the will to survive in adverse situations is necessary.
One day, Yang Kai, a disciple-on-trial (and floor sweeper) of the Lingxiao Martial Arts Sect discovered a Wordless Black Book. That marked the turn in his luck and the beginning of his martial arts journey.

title: Rebirth Of The Ultimate Master
blurb:
What happens when a former martial emperor gets reborn into a complete loser's body? Gu Feiyang, a legendary martial artist who was ranked third-strongest in the continent, finds himself in this predicament when he wakes up in the body of 15-year-old Li Yunxiao. Li Yunxiao was once a failure who had yet to open a single chakra portal in his body, but now he's morphed into a genius martial artist overnight and becomes the talk (and target) of the town. Armed with the expertise of his former life, Li Yunxiao is on a mission to complete the ultimate incantation that killed him in the first place - all while wiping the floor with his former bullies at school. Will he be able to exceed the accomplishments of his previous life? One thing's for certain: no one will ever call him a loser again!




Note: The title of the manhua changed from 万古至尊 to 这一世我要当至尊 starting from Ch. 14.

title: The Broken Ring: This Marriage Will Fail Anyway
blurb:
When six-year-old Inés laid eyes on the handsome heir to House Escalante, she promptly made the boy her fiancé. Since noble men are all the same, she figured she might as well choose a pretty one. But Lord Cárcel isn't ready for this sort of commitment just yet, and he spends the next decade and a half avoiding the marriage at all costs! Luckily, that's no trouble for Inés, as this marriage failing is exactly what she wants. In fact, he has her blessing to sow his wild oats as long as he stays out of her business. Unfortunately, being a playboy isn't as fun when your fiancée gives you permission. And doesn't this mean she's cheating on him too? Now, Cárcel is determined to change Inés' mind about him and prove he can be the husband she's always wanted.



Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Chinese followed by Korean, making it a manhua by AniList standards.

title: Doomsday: Virus Monarch
blurb: When the apocalypse descends, the world transforms into a brutal game of evolution—humanity’s final trial, and the favorite playground of gods and demons. Brian Carter time-travels back to ten days before it all begins. Armed with foreknowledge and no time to waste, he injects himself with the zombie virus and awakens a legendary SSS ability: Virus Monarch! Now, with the power to command infection itself, Brian forges a terrifying new path through the chaos, one where he doesn’t just survive the end of the world, but rules it!

title: Full-Time Sword Cultivator
blurb: In an era where reality and a game had become one, Lin Jichen, the greatest mage in Eternia, was stabbed in the back and killed by the people he trusted the most—his lover and the man he considered his brother. Yet destiny had other plans for him. He regressed to the day before Eternia’s launch and gave up the staff for a sword! Join him on a journey to rewrite the future with the blade of a sword!

title: Soul Pact: Working for an Evil God to Pay Off My Debt
blurb: Office worker Charrion Zacarias suddenly transmigrates into a world of magic only to inherit a dying boy's staggering debt of billions! As if that weren't bad enough, the boy's failed attempt to summon the Dark God leaves Charrion bound by a soul contract which is to fulfill the Dark God's 999 wishes or face complete annihilation. His only hope is that mysterious talking notebook known as God's Notebook. A modern-day salaryman take on a ruthless, power-driven world, using workplace savvy, relentless hustle, and relentless training to defy fate. The servant of the Dark God refuses to give up!

title: All Hail The Sect Leader
blurb: All the members of my sect are abnormally strong. All my disciples turn out to be big shots, and I'll definitely become invincible in this world!

title: Kaiju Qian Dao Huanggu Shengti
blurb: Jun Xiaoyao transmigrated into a fantastical world and into the body of the scion of a prominent clan, which will give him powerful backers and incredible talent. He is also given the Login System, which provided him with a fully-formed ancient sacred body right from the start. With the help of his System, he will march to the pinnacle of this world!

title: Conglíngkaishi Wuxian Jinhua
blurb: Use it all, break through limits. Innate wisdom, academic pinnacle. Multiple forms, transcending evolution. Reborn, starting from scratch, infinitely evolving.

title: Lucky Me: I Secretly Cultivated for 1,000 Years
blurb: Reborn into a world of immortal cultivation, Han Jue found himself blessed with the Gacha System, able to re-roll for stats in cultivation and luck. To stay out of trouble, Han Jue cultivated on his own, and kept quiet about his special abilities. But when his sect faced destruction, he stepped up to defend it. A thousand years later, after many generations of cultivation, the immortals were planning to cleanse the mortal realm, and Han Jue was finally forced to act. That was when he discovered that even gods and immortals were not as powerful as he had imagined…

title: My Passive Skills Hit Like a Truck
blurb: In his past life, Edmund Cheng clawed his way to the top of "Apocalypse," earning god-tier titles in every class, only to fall one step short of becoming the world's number one. Death wasn't the end. He wakes in a new world, running on the exact same rules as "Apocalypse," except now it's real, and everyone gets one shot at awakening a class. While others are still fumbling through the basics, Edmund already knows every hidden class, every secret path. He's done this before. Now, armed with the glory he never got to claim, he'll forge a path no one has ever walked—and this time, he'll take his place at the top.

title: Global Awakening: I Awakened Celestial Lightning
blurb: Raiden Xu transmigrated into a world where anyone could awaken their own unique ability, yet he awakened the weakest E-Rank ability. But just as everyone thought he was destined for mediocrity, the system awakened! E-Rank Low Voltage has been upgraded to the S-Rank Celestial Fulgur! Take down monsters, farm Ability Points, and embark on an endless journey of growth and evolution! Once its limits were transcended, Raiden came to realize the bolt in his grasp was now the SSS-Rank Bolt of Chaos that could decimate the world! From an unknown E-Rank to an unparalleled powerhouse, Raiden’s legend begins here!

title: My Disciples Are All Villains
blurb:
When Lu Zhou wakes up one morning, he finds himself in a rather prickly situation. He has become the most powerful and the oldest villain in the world. He has nine disciples, each of whom has a full record of misdeeds. His first disciple is the head of the Nether Sect, served by thousands of followers. Known as the Sword Demon, his second disciple kills anyone who displeases him. Having lost his powers, how is he going to discipline his wicked disciples?
“I make a clean sweep of all obstacles wherever I go. Nobody can walk all over me except my master,”
says Yu Zhenghai, his first disciple.
“I can’t rest easy until my master is dead,”
says Si Wuya, his seventh disciple.

title: Dumped... Then I Became a Martial God
blurb: What’s the first thing Rhys Valdez does after being reborn into the recent past, realizing he has a second chance to correct any past mistakes? He breaks up with his girlfriend, setting up for a romantic saga of star-crossed lovers... until, that is, a mysterious System awakens and reveals that Earth’s impending Spiritual Energy Revival is merely one short year away from triggering the apocalypse. With the knowledge of the past and power of the future, can Rhys ascend the Realms of Cultivation in time to save humanity?

title: Tales of Demons and Gods
blurb: Because of the Space-Time Demon Spirit Book, time and space underwent a reversal. Though he was supposed to have died to demon beasts, Nie Li found himself sitting in a classroom when he opened his eyes. He had gone back to the age of thirteen. Now that everything has begun anew... how will he protect his beloved?

title: Astral Sutra
blurb:
In the whole world there lays twelve paths to climb the Tower of God, and in legends these twelve pathways leads toward legendary road of immortality. However these paths in the Tower of God, are far too long, without end.

In ancient times there once were many types of martial art, sadly the world underwent terrible changes, and only three were left: Flame, Dragon and Star Martial Arts. Generations of experts of those three martial arts are searching for road of immortality.

Star Martial Arts practitioner on his journey of lifetime, with young beauties on the side, plans to become Highest God.

title: I Am The Fated Villain
blurb: A transmigrator awoke in the world of martial arts and became the villain named Gu Changge. His goal is to harvest the luck of those called "the Son of Fate" in order to become the strongest. With the Sons of Fate as his deranged enemies, he changes the destiny of being a villain.

title: I Get A Random New Occupation Every Week
blurb: When Lin Yi was fired from his job, he triggered the Career Experience System by accident. The System offered Lin Yi various career opportunities and generous rewards for completing its missions. He took advantage of those rewards to achieve his ambitions of skills, riches, and power.

title: Eternal Loop: A Thousand-Year Grind
blurb: Wu Chen is stuck in an endless time loop, reliving the same day over and over again—July 7th, 2020. No matter what he does, the clock resets. Over a thousand years, he's mastered hundreds of languages and every instrument imaginable, and perfected skills in fighting, driving, shooting, cooking, dancing, acting...and more. But on this very day, something changes. July 8th, 2020 finally arrives...

title: From Simp to Billionaire: The Rise of a Divine Tycoon
blurb: Lin Xinben was just your ordinary simp. After getting dumped, he received the Shenhao System, which gave him billions to spend right away! But the painful part is that he must spend that money on girls! Oh well, in order to put the money use, Lin Xin will embark on a strange journey of revenge, by becoming a godly playboy!

title: Demon Lord: My Twists with Female Disciples
blurb: Bai Feng gets sucked into a romance game, and guess who he becomes? The notorious Dark Overlord, Bai Qingling. In this world, Bai Qingling's the ultimate bad guy: cold, ruthless, obsessed with immortality, and known for dark cultivation and making human puppets. And to top it off, he sees his three female disciples as nothing but pawns. Basically, he's the final boss everyone hates. Now, Bai Feng's gotta use the [Universal Love System] to flip this script and survive. Watch as he turns this nightmare into something else entirely.

title: Love by Mistake
blurb: The acclaimed financial reporter Sylvie Jaine is cheated on? No way she'd sit back and watch that scumbag and his sweet-faced side piece ride off into the sunset! But when she sees that mistress's uncle's luxurious Rolls-Royce, she has an idea: she'll go after the CEO herself! So this bastard wants to take a shortcut to success? No problem. Watch her become their aunt-in-law instead!

title: Goblin's Ascent: From Loser to Winner
blurb: After waking up in a goblin's body and getting brutally killed by humans, Jace Hurley triggers a life simulation game system. By continuously evolving, the blessed goblin crawls all the way up to become the world's strongest fighter. The Saint of Swords, the dragon mother Fryrmiel, angels, and goddesses have all succumbed to his charms.

title: All-Class Awakening: God Slayer
blurb: Elias Bai, Captain of God's Legion, stood as the world's strongest Awakener until a brutal betrayal claimed his entire squad. Dying as a mere pawn of the ruling elite, he suddenly wakes up twenty years in the past—back in middle school, long before his awakening. With his loved ones still alive, Elias refuses to let history repeat itself. To save his team, exact vengeance on the traitor, and overthrow the corrupt system, he must walk a lonely road to unrivaled power.

title: My Virtual Immortal Path
blurb: How arduous the Immortal Path truly is! And even more so in a cultivation world utterly transformed by a devastating plague. Mortals carry the pestilence within their bodies and once immortals come into contact with it, the best outcome is a drop in cultivation while the worst would be a return of their Dao to Heaven itself. Thus, immortals and mortals are forever divided. I crossed into this world filled with boundless ambition, yet could only struggle and flounder in the mortal realm, wasting away an entire lifetime. Fortunately, at the moment of my death, I finally awakened an extraordinary treasure—one that could turn reality into illusions, transforming a genuine life into nothing more than a fleeting dream, and send me back to the very moment I first transmigrated into this world. And so, my long road to immortality began.

title: The Laid Off Demon King
blurb: He is the king of the demon world who has become unemployed because of impeachment. She was the brave hero who was laid off because of the failure of the expedition. The bond of destiny binds the two together as they embark on an journey full of unknown adventures.

title: Fei Ren Zai
blurb: Chinese mythical beasts living in modern China.

title: Rise of the Mountain Chief
blurb: Our protagonist embarks on a journey from a humble mountain village, accompanied by two companions: a strategist and a groom. His goal is to transform the village into the strongest mountain stronghold. He arrives in a chaotic world where he inherits a dilapidated mountain fortress. In the face of this tumultuous and deadly environment, he faces a critical choice: Will he resort to robbing money, food, and women to become a carefree king of the mountain? Or will he pour his heart and soul into battling the heroes of the world, striving to earn a name that will echo throughout the universe? Is anyone truly born destined to be a king, duke, general, or minister?

title: Super Gene
blurb: In the future, countless alien beasts will invade across the universe. Humans that devour the alien flesh can absorb their genetic powers, which ushered in an era of rapid genetic evolution. Han Sen, a newcomer to the base, became known as the "butt fiend" and despised by others. But in secret, he's actually the overpowered "B God" admired by everyone! Han Sen: Sorry, only I can take on the ultimate god-gene!

title: Starting Over as a Tree
blurb: One minute, he was choking on water, and the next, he found himself in a canyon and turned into a willow tree! Before he could reconcile with this new sad reality, the world decided to throw him another curveball. With the return of spirit energy, every living thing started to mutate, and his life was soon turned into a game of survival. Luckily, he was gifted with the ability of infinite evolution. But was it really a blessing? Or was it also a curse in disguise?

title: Mr. Zombie
blurb: 1000 years ago, the MC became a normal zombie in the apocalypse. In order to survive the constant hunting of humans, he continued to train himself until he became immensely powerful. After 1000 years passed, he is now ready to enter human society again.

title: With My Netherworld Trillions, Game On!
blurb: After defying death's grip, Yu Lin awakens the "Divine Tycoon System," which grants him daily cash payouts. But there's a catch: the money is unusable Nether Tokens. Years later, he gets chosen as one of the lucky few to beta-test Global Menace, a horror game where only the best and strongest can survive. While others are frantically appeasing the fierce spirits, Yu Lin recruits loyal ghost followers with his Tycoon spending. Looks like having money is all you need to rule the underworld!

title: I Am Invincible: Start From Awing My Empress Wife
blurb: When Ning Tian opens his eyes in the Celestial World, he’s stunned to find himself in the Queen’s private bedchamber! Once dismissed as a useless good-for-nothing, he’s now set to marry the peerless Queen Luo Wuqing tonight! Just as everyone’s jaws hit the floor, a mysterious system appears and tells him, “Shock others to earn rewards!” From astonishing the Queen to shaking the entire world, Ning Tian begins an unstoppable rise that will leave everyone trembling!

title: Tale of Old Snake Cultivation
blurb: In a quiet mountain village, an old serpent accidentally swallowed a mysterious cultivator's elixir—and in that moment, its mind awakened. From then on, it embarked on a perilous and exhilarating journey toward immortality. In just ten short years, it defied the ravages of time, racing against fate itself. It hunted demons, vanquished evil spirits, and carved its path against the will of heaven. This is the legendary tale of a serpent's ascension—from the dust of the mortal world to the boundless skies beyond. A saga of transformation, courage, and defiance begins.

title: God-Tier Assassin: I Am the Shadow
blurb: The mysterious game God’s Forsaken has descended upon Earth. In this world, players can gain lifespan by slaying monsters—and even better, they can expend that lifespan to manifest their in-game powers into reality! As supernatural abilities awaken, global chaos and disasters follow in their wake. In his previous life, Qin Feng fought tooth and nail to protect his sister, Qin Xiaoyou, eventually rising to become one of the top 100 powerhouses in the world. However, his devotion was met with the ultimate betrayal. Blinded by her obsession with a celebrity idol, his own sister gouged out his eyes to steal his "Ancient God’s Eyeballs" as a gift for her star. Now, reborn and sent back to the very beginning, Qin Feng has returned. This time, he will trust no one. Embracing the darkness, he chooses to walk the path of a god-tier assassin to become the strongest—alone!

title: Whispers of Telepathy
blurb: After being unfairly crushed to death, Jiujiu ends up in the underworld, bickering with Yama. In a bid to silence her endless rambling, he reincarnates her into a novel—as a princess. But not just any princess—she’s an exiled royal trapped in the infamous Cold Palace! One day, thanks to the scheming heroine of the novel, Jiujiu’s biological father—the tyrant emperor—flies into a rage and prepares to beat her to death! Burning with fury and injustice, Jiujiu cries out in her heart: “With a cruel, ruthless tyrant completely blind to right and wrong, it’s no wonder the Western Chu Kingdom will fall in ten years! It’s a miracle it could even last that long!” To her surprise, the emperor suddenly freezes—he can hear her thoughts! With her mind exposed, has Jiujiu just sealed her fate—or changed her destiny forever?!

title: The Summoner: Apocalypse Rewinds
blurb: When the Players from beyond the stars turned the peaceful Blue Star into their personal slaughterhouse, all hope seemed lost. But the system made a fatal error, unlocking the ultimate hidden class for Lin Yuan: the Necro Hunter. He's the glitch they never saw coming—an NPC who came back from death with the power to hunt the mighty Players. The game for Blue Star's survival is about to be rewritten, and he's leading the charge with vengeance.

title: The Glutton: Devourer of Kings
blurb: Humanity's world was destroyed by the Demon Kings. Stripped of everything, Awakener Ash Si sacrificed himself in a devastating explosion to drag Demon King Voralune, The Glutton, down to hell. Instead of death, he opens his eyes ten years in the past, long before the tragedy occurred. He discovers his powers have awakened early, and surprisingly, he also possesses Voralune’s power of Gluttony. Armed with this advantage, Ash decides to act in advance. With his return, everything in the world seems to be changing...

title: Bing Jiao Nü Xuesheng Chengle Wo de Shangsi
blurb: Lin Shuo, the dreaded “Devil Teacher” who is feared by everyone, finds herself blushing in private when teased by one of her former students.

title: Wo Zai Hehuan Zong Mai Xiao Wanju
blurb: Item-reliant players are all cultists! Hehuan dual cultivation is the true path! When item-reliant players who’ve worked hard to improve face off against naturally gifted prodigies from the Hehuan Sect, isn’t their battle in the bedroom just another way of showing their passion for learning?

title: Gao Wu: Zhisou Heng Tui Sanqian Di!
Wangling Fashi: Cong Kulou Fenshen Kaishi Cheng Shen
blurb: The main character awakens the useless class "Necromancer" — but gains a skeleton clone in the underworld. Using this skeleton clone to kill monsters and level up in the underworld, he feeds the power back to his main body, continuously growing stronger. This is not limited to satisfying the feeling of pleasant growth for a character who depends on cultivation, but also takes advantage of information asymmetry to repeatedly create opportunities for "playing the fool to crush the strong." From a single skeleton, he embarks on the road to godhood.

title: The Ravages of Time
blurb:
Nearly 2000 years ago, the prosperous Han dynasty of China collapsed. Heroes rose and fell, and three nations emerged--Wei, Shu, and Wu. Historians refer to this period as the Three Kingdoms period. The romance of the three kingdoms is an intriguing tale of heroic deeds, of alliance forged and broken, of loyalty and betrayal.
Hong Kong artist Chan Mou retells this classic tale in "The Ravages of Time" from the perspective of the Sima clan, which in the end united the three kingdoms. Readers will be attracted by an array of well-developed characters and Chan Mou's own unique top-notch art-style.

title: 19 Tian
blurb:
A group photo in kindergarten is the start of a lifetime friendship between Jian Yi and Zhan Zhengxi. They grew up together, and met good friends like He Tian and Mo Guanshan on campus.

"19 Days" not only shows the relaxed and happy school days of the four, but is also a story in which the boys come to understand each other and help each other grow up.

title: Jiang Ye
blurb: One of Tang Dynasty’s ordinary soldiers, a small yet courageous boy, Ning Que, received an order to escort a carriage. He bids his farwell to Weicheng, and heads towards Chang An!
